evidence.description: A white Mercedes, jewelry, silverware and personal documents were taken while the owner was away on a trip
The stolen Mercedes was recovered in Seattle in mid December with swapped license plates

notes: Only the month is reported. The series is described in KIRO 7 as burglaries between November 2024 and February 2025 across Seattle, Medina, Sammamish and Everett. The article says fingerprints on a recovered stolen vehicle linked the defendant to the crimes but does not say which vehicle.
